name: Proof of Custody — Bitcoin Custody and IRA Provider Scores
description: Independently-scored dataset of Bitcoin custody, exchange, IRA, ETF, and yield platforms. Six-category weighted scoring methodology applied consistently across all providers.
citation: Proof of Custody (https://proofofcustody.io). Bitcoin Custody and IRA Provider Scores Dataset, version 2026.09.

featuresDefinition.appliedToTheseScores: Product catalogue breadth (IRA, lending, inheritance, dynasty trusts, DCA, Lightning, card rewards). In force until 2026-09-23.
featuresDefinition.current: Custody-relevant capability only: recovery options, inheritance mechanism, withdrawal controls, trust and entity titling, exit and migration. Adopted 2026-09-23.
featuresDefinition.why: The old definition rewarded product breadth, and this site is published by a company that sells several of those products. Scores in this file were produced under the old definition and are recomputed under the new one at the date above.

methodology.note: Bitcoin IRA pages carry a separate IRA-specific rubric, documented on the methodology page. It does not produce the scores in this file.

data.name: Onramp
data.highlight: Only platform with multiple regulated custodians and jurisdictions. Inheritance, dynasty trusts, insurance on segregated incidents.
data.risk: Higher minimums. Newer platform with smaller user base than legacy exchanges.

data.name: Onramp Finance
data.highlight: Lowest cost one-time buys at 59bps. Earn 3% on cash, 1.5% card rewards, lending available.
data.risk: Single party custody through BitGo. Not multi-institution.

data.name: Unchained
data.highlight: 2-of-3 multisig where client holds 2 keys. Strong inheritance and IRA products. Lending available.
data.risk: Client holds hardware devices, creating physical exposure. Single company as co-signer.

data.name: Unchained
data.highlight: Buy directly into collaborative custody. IRA, lending, and inheritance built in.
data.risk: Requires hardware key management. Higher learning curve for new users.

data.name: Onramp Lending
data.highlight: Borrow against BTC with multi-institution collateral custody. No rehypothecation.
data.risk: Higher minimums. Newer lending product. Liquidation risk in volatility.

data.name: Casa
data.highlight: Best self-custody UX. Mobile key management. Inheritance protocol.
data.risk: You hold all keys. Recovery requires planning. Physical exposure risk.

data.name: Circle (USDC)
data.highlight: USDC reserves custodied by BlackRock (Circle Reserve Fund) and BNY Mellon. Monthly attestations by Deloitte. Most transparent stablecoin issuer and GENIUS Act ready.
data.risk: Circle operates as a single issuer entity. Reserves are diversified across institutions but redemption depends on Circle's operational continuity.

data.name: River
data.highlight: Zero-fee recurring buys. Lightning withdrawals. Strong research content.
data.risk: Single custodian holds all keys. Withdrawal to self-custody recommended.

data.name: Foundation (Passport)
data.highlight: Open source hardware and software. Beautiful industrial design. Bitcoin-only.
data.risk: Smaller company. Physical exposure risk. Self-custody burden.

data.name: Unchained IRA
data.highlight: IRA in collaborative multisig. Client holds keys. Tax-advantaged Bitcoin.
data.risk: Requires hardware devices. SDIRA complexity. IRS reporting burden.

data.name: Unchained IRA
data.highlight: Only IRA where you hold keys. 2-of-3 multisig. Tax-advantaged Bitcoin.
data.risk: Requires hardware devices. SDIRA complexity. IRS reporting burden.

data.name: BlackRock BUIDL
data.highlight: Largest tokenized treasury fund ($2.5B+). BlackRock as asset manager, Securitize as tokenization agent, BNY Mellon as custodian. Daily NAV. Multi-chain deployment across 7 networks.
data.risk: Accredited investor requirement. Minimum investment reduced but still institutional-oriented. Smart contract risk on multiple chains. SEC-registered but novel structure.

data.name: Swan Bitcoin
data.highlight: IRA offerings. Swan Vault for collaborative custody. Strong educational community.
data.risk: Primary custody through partner custodian. Vault option available for larger holders.

data.name: Unchained Lending
data.highlight: Borrow against BTC in collaborative custody. Client holds keys to collateral.
data.risk: Higher rates than TradFi. Liquidation risk. Requires hardware setup.

data.name: Paxos
data.highlight: NY DFS-regulated trust company. Issues PYUSD for PayPal, USDP, and Pax Gold (PAXG). Monthly attestations by WithumSmith+Brown. Strongest regulatory position of any stablecoin issuer.
data.risk: Single entity risk. Paxos was ordered by NY DFS to stop minting BUSD in 2023. B2B focus means limited direct consumer access.

data.name: Franklin Templeton BENJI
data.highlight: First SEC-registered fund to use public blockchain for share tracking. Franklin OnChain US Government Money Fund accessible via the Benji app. $700M+ AUM. Stellar and Ethereum deployment.
data.risk: Single asset manager controls fund operations. On-chain component is share tracking, not direct asset custody. Minimum investment for direct access.

data.name: Relai
data.highlight: Bitcoin-only. European. Auto-DCA directly to your own wallet.
data.risk: Limited to European users. Fewer financial services than US alternatives.

data.name: Securitize
data.highlight: Leading tokenization platform. SEC-registered transfer agent and FINRA broker-dealer. Powers BlackRock BUIDL, Hamilton Lane, KKR tokenized funds. Secondary market trading via Securitize Markets.
data.risk: Single platform dependency for tokenization and transfer agent services. Revenue concentrated in few large clients. Smart contract risk.

data.name: iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT)
data.highlight: Largest spot Bitcoin ETF by AUM. BlackRock brand. Deep liquidity.
data.risk: Single custodian (Coinbase). No direct BTC withdrawal. Counterparty risk via shares.

data.name: BNY Mellon
data.highlight: World's largest custodian bank ($52T+ in assets under custody). Holds USDC cash reserves for Circle. Custodies assets for 11 Bitcoin ETFs. Unmatched regulatory credibility and balance sheet.
data.risk: Traditional bank infrastructure — slower innovation than crypto-native custodians. Digital asset custody is a small fraction of overall business. Premium institutional pricing.

data.name: Fidelity Digital Assets
data.highlight: Backed by Fidelity's brand and balance sheet. Regulated. SOC 2 Type 2.
data.risk: Single custodian. Traditional finance approach to a novel asset class.

data.name: Fidelity Wise Origin (FBTC)
data.highlight: Fidelity self-custodies BTC. Trusted brand. Integrated with brokerage accounts.
data.risk: Single custodian (Fidelity). No direct BTC withdrawal.

data.name: Ondo Finance
data.highlight: OUSG backed by BlackRock BUIDL. USDY is a yield-bearing stablecoin alternative. Multi-chain deployment (Ethereum, Solana, Mantle, Sui, Aptos). Strong DeFi composability. Combined $1B+ TVL.
data.risk: Single platform risk. Newer entity (founded 2022). USDY structural complexity as a tokenized note. Ankura Trust as trustee adds intermediary layer.

data.name: Paxos Gold (PAXG)
data.highlight: Each PAXG token backed by one troy ounce of London Good Delivery gold in Brink's vaults. NY DFS regulated. Monthly attestations. Unique: individual bar serial number lookup per token holder.
data.risk: Paxos as single issuer and regulatory entity. Physical gold concentration in London vaults. Minimum 430 PAXG ($1M+) for physical redemption.

data.name: Bridge (by Stripe)
data.highlight: Acquired by Stripe for $1.1B. Stablecoin orchestration layer powering cross-border payments, on/off-ramps, and stablecoin issuance for enterprises. Developer-first API design.
data.risk: Newer platform with limited public track record on custody. Stripe acquisition is recent (2024). Infrastructure layer — does not hold reserves directly.

data.name: BitGo
data.highlight: Qualified custodian with multi-sig architecture. $250M insurance policy. Custodies stablecoin reserves and provides settlement infrastructure. Used by stablecoin issuers and exchanges.
data.risk: Single institutional custodian despite multi-sig. Galaxy Digital acquisition (2023) changed ownership. Concentration risk at scale.

data.name: Bitwise Bitcoin ETF (BITB)
data.highlight: Crypto-native issuer. Transparent on-chain proof of reserves. Competitive fees.
data.risk: Single custodian (Coinbase). Smaller issuer brand recognition.

data.name: Fidelity Crypto
data.highlight: Trusted brand. Integrated with existing Fidelity accounts.
data.risk: Limited to three cryptocurrencies. Single custodian.

data.name: Strike
data.highlight: Near-zero fees on some purchases. Lightning-native. Simple DCA.
data.risk: Limited custody features. Designed for buying and sending, not long-term holding.

data.name: Choice by Kingdom Trust
data.highlight: Regulated IRA custodian. Bitcoin + alts. Roth and Traditional.
data.risk: Single custodian. Higher fees than traditional IRAs. Newer platform.

data.name: Choice by Kingdom Trust
data.highlight: Regulated IRA custodian. Bitcoin + alts. Roth and Traditional.
data.risk: Single custodian. Higher fees than traditional IRAs. Newer platform.

data.name: PayPal (PYUSD)
data.highlight: PYUSD issued by Paxos under NY DFS regulation. Monthly attestations. Distributed through PayPal and Venmo to 400M+ users. Largest fintech stablecoin by distribution reach.
data.risk: PayPal is the distribution layer, not the custodian. Reserve custody depends on Paxos infrastructure. Limited DeFi composability compared to USDC. PayPal can freeze user accounts.

data.name: Anchorage Digital
data.highlight: First OCC-chartered crypto bank. Custodies stablecoin reserves for multiple issuers. SOC 1 & 2 compliant. Banking-grade custody infrastructure for digital assets.
data.risk: Does not use multisig — relies on proprietary key management. Single institutional custodian. Premium pricing limits access. OCC charter is novel and untested in stress scenarios.

data.name: BitGo
data.highlight: Qualified custodian. Hot, warm, and cold wallet options. $250M insurance.
data.risk: Single institutional custodian. Concentration risk at scale.

data.name: Trezor
data.highlight: Pioneer hardware wallet. Open source. User-friendly. Broad coin support.
data.risk: Physical exposure. Extraction vulnerabilities disclosed. Self-custody burden.

data.name: ARK 21Shares (ARKB)
data.highlight: Cathie Wood/ARK branding. Lower expense ratio. Innovation-focused audience.
data.risk: Single custodian (Coinbase). Smaller AUM. ARK reputation volatility.

data.name: Bitcoin Well
data.highlight: Non-custodial Bitcoin buying in Canada. Auto-DCA. Bill pay with BTC.
data.risk: Higher fees. Canada-only. Smaller platform.

data.name: Debifi
data.highlight: P2P BTC-backed loans. Multisig escrow. No KYC required.
data.risk: Smaller platform. P2P counterparty risk. Limited liquidity.

data.name: Franklin Bitcoin ETF (EZBC)
data.highlight: Franklin Templeton brand. Among lowest expense ratios. Established asset manager.
data.risk: Single custodian (Coinbase). Smaller AUM. Limited crypto expertise.

data.name: Ripple (RLUSD)
data.highlight: NY DFS-approved stablecoin launched December 2024. Reserves in USD deposits and short-term US Treasuries. Monthly attestations. Available on XRPL and Ethereum.
data.risk: Very new product (launched Dec 2024). Limited track record. Ripple has unresolved SEC litigation history. Smaller market cap.

data.name: Strike (Global)
data.highlight: Global remittances. Near-zero fee BTC buys. Lightning-native.
data.risk: Custodial. Limited markets. Not designed for large holdings.

data.name: Sygnum
data.highlight: Swiss banking license. Tokenization services. Regulated digital asset bank.
data.risk: Single custodian. Swiss jurisdiction only. Premium pricing.

data.name: Anchorage
data.highlight: OCC-chartered crypto bank. Staking, trading, settlement. SOC 1 & 2.
data.risk: Does not use multisig. Single institutional custodian.

data.name: Cash App
data.highlight: Easiest onboarding. Auto-invest feature. Lightning withdrawals.
data.risk: Single custodian. Limited custody options. Bitcoin is one feature among many.

data.name: Grayscale Bitcoin Mini (BTC)
data.highlight: Lowest expense ratio among spot BTC ETFs. Spin-off from GBTC.
data.risk: Single custodian (Coinbase). Smaller AUM. Newer product.

data.name: Swan IRA
data.highlight: Simple Bitcoin IRA setup. Swan brand trust. Auto-DCA into IRA.
data.risk: Single custodian for IRA assets. Higher fees than brokerage.

data.name: VanEck Bitcoin ETF (HODL)
data.highlight: VanEck brand. Gemini as custodian (not Coinbase). Competitive fees.
data.risk: Single custodian (Gemini). Smaller AUM than IBIT/FBTC.

data.name: Copper
data.highlight: Off-exchange settlement via ClearLoop. MPC technology.
data.risk: MPC is not multisig. Single technology provider. UK-based.

data.name: Swan IRA
data.highlight: Simple Bitcoin IRA setup. Swan brand trust. Auto-DCA into IRA.
data.risk: Single custodian for IRA assets. Higher fees than brokerage.

data.name: Kraken
data.highlight: Competitive fees. Proof of reserves published. Strong security track record.
data.risk: Single custodian. Broader crypto exchange, not Bitcoin-focused.

data.name: Broad Financial
data.highlight: Checkbook control SDIRA. Hold BTC in personal wallet via IRA LLC. Full control.
data.risk: IRS compliance complexity. Self-custody burden. Setup complexity.

data.name: Fireblocks
data.highlight: MPC-based custody infrastructure used by 1,800+ institutions. Powers stablecoin custody for multiple issuers and custodians. Broadest DeFi connectivity of any infrastructure provider.
data.risk: MPC is not multisig — key shards can be reconstituted by Fireblocks. Single technology provider dependency. Not a custodian itself, but infrastructure. Proprietary technology, not open-source.

data.name: Gemini
data.highlight: SOC 2 certified. New York regulated. Insurance on hot wallet.
data.risk: Higher fees. Single custodian. Broader crypto exchange.

data.name: iTrust Capital
data.highlight: Crypto IRA with 30+ assets. 24/7 trading. Roth and Traditional.
data.risk: Single custodian. Broad crypto focus, not Bitcoin-specialized.

data.name: Xapo Bank
data.highlight: Gibraltar-licensed bank. USD interest + BTC exposure. Debit card.
data.risk: Single custodian. Offshore jurisdiction. Premium service only.

data.name: Bitcoin Suisse
data.highlight: Swiss pioneer in crypto financial services. Staking, trading, custody.
data.risk: Single custodian. Swiss-focused. Premium pricing.

data.name: Coinbase
data.highlight: Most user-friendly. Broadest crypto selection. Public company with regulatory clarity.
data.risk: Single custodian for massive asset pool. Terms allow asset claims in bankruptcy.

data.name: Shakepay
data.highlight: Canadian Bitcoin app. Shake for sats feature. Visa card with BTC rewards.
data.risk: Single custodian. Canada-only. Spread-based pricing.

data.name: Tether Gold (XAUT)
data.highlight: Each XAUT token represents ownership of one troy ounce of London Good Delivery gold stored in Swiss vaults. Available on Ethereum and Tron. Redeemable for physical gold delivery.
data.risk: Same transparency concerns as Tether (USDT). BDO Italia attestations, not full audits. Tether controls vault access and redemption. No individual bar serial number lookup (unlike PAXG).

data.name: Zodia Custody
data.highlight: Backed by Standard Chartered and Northern Trust.
data.risk: Single custodian. Newer entrant. Limited track record.

data.name: Fireblocks
data.highlight: Multi-party computation infrastructure. 1,800+ institutions. Broad DeFi connectivity.
data.risk: MPC is not multisig. Key shards can be reconstituted. Single technology provider.

data.name: Fold
data.highlight: Bitcoin-back debit card. Daily spin rewards. Round-up purchases.
data.risk: Single custodian. Gamification may encourage poor habits. Not focused on custody.

data.name: Gemini Custody
data.highlight: SOC 2 certified. New York trust company. Insurance on assets.
data.risk: Single custodian. Broader crypto focus, not Bitcoin-specialized.

data.name: Invesco Galaxy (BTCO)
data.highlight: Invesco + Galaxy Digital partnership. Established asset manager.
data.risk: Single custodian (Coinbase). Less differentiation from peers.

data.name: Ledn
data.highlight: BTC-backed loans. B2X product to double BTC exposure. Proof of reserves.
data.risk: Single custodian. Rehypothecation concerns. Counterparty risk.

data.name: Tether (USDT)
data.highlight: Largest stablecoin by market cap ($145B+). Deepest liquidity across all exchanges and chains. Dominant in emerging market remittance and trading.
data.risk: No full independent audit has ever been published. Quarterly attestations by BDO Italia provide limited assurance. Reserve composition has historically included commercial paper and secured loans. GENIUS Act compliance is uncertain.

data.name: Coinbase Custody
data.highlight: Largest custodian by assets. Qualified custodian. ETF custody provider.
data.risk: Massive honeypot. Single point of failure at unprecedented scale.

data.name: Hodl Hodl
data.highlight: P2P Bitcoin trading. Multisig escrow. No KYC. Global.
data.risk: P2P counterparty risk. Lower liquidity. Slower than exchanges.

data.name: Valkyrie Bitcoin (BRRR)
data.highlight: Crypto-focused issuer. Now under CoinShares brand.
data.risk: Single custodian (Coinbase). Smaller AUM. Brand transition.

data.name: Bitcoin IRA
data.highlight: First Bitcoin IRA platform. Insurance on assets. Simple setup.
data.risk: Opaque fee structure. Single custodian. Premium pricing.

data.name: Bitrefill
data.highlight: Buy gift cards with Bitcoin. Lightning payments. Live on Bitcoin.
data.risk: Not a custody platform. Gift card premium. Limited spending options.

data.name: Hashdex Bitcoin ETF (DEFI)
data.highlight: Defunct — delisted 24 Aug 2026 (SEC Form 25-NSE). Historical record.
data.risk: Delisted and liquidating. NYSE Arca filed Form 25-NSE for the Hashdex Commodities Trust (DEFI) on 24 August 2026; the fund is no longer a live custody option and this record is kept as history.

data.name: WisdomTree Bitcoin (BTCW)
data.highlight: WisdomTree expertise in commodity ETFs. Familiar structure.
data.risk: Single custodian (Coinbase). Smaller AUM. Limited differentiation.

data.name: Arch (Bitcoin-Backed Loans)
data.highlight: Institutional BTC lending. Qualified custodian holds collateral. Low LTV options.
data.risk: Single custodian for collateral. Liquidation risk. Premium rates.

data.name: Ledger
data.highlight: Most popular hardware wallet globally. Broad app ecosystem.
data.risk: Closed-source secure element. Ledger Recover controversy. Physical exposure.

data.name: Alto IRA
data.highlight: Crypto IRA alongside alternative investments. Simple interface.
data.risk: Single custodian. Monthly fees add up. Broad focus, not BTC-specialized.

data.name: Coldcard
data.highlight: Air-gapped signing. Open source firmware. Most security-focused hardware wallet.
data.risk: Full self-custody responsibility. Physical device exposure. Kidnapping and extortion risk.

data.name: Swan Force
data.highlight: Bitcoin benefits for employees. Employer-sponsored DCA. 401k integration.
data.risk: Custodial. Employer-dependent. Limited to participating companies.

data.name: Strike Rewards
data.highlight: Earn BTC rewards on paycheck deposits. Simple and automatic.
data.risk: Custodial. Small reward amounts. Not a yield product per se.

data.name: Lolli
data.highlight: Bitcoin cashback on online shopping. Browser extension. 1,000+ merchants.
data.risk: Single custodian. Small BTC amounts. Not a custody solution.

data.name: BitIRA
data.highlight: Cold storage IRA. Insurance through Lloyd's. Physical security emphasis.
data.risk: High fees. Single custodian. Limited self-custody options.

data.name: Grayscale Bitcoin Trust (GBTC)
data.highlight: Longest-running BTC fund. Converted from trust to ETF. Deep brand recognition.
data.risk: Highest expense ratio among peers. Massive outflows post-conversion. Coinbase custody.

data.name: Robinhood
data.highlight: Commission-free trading. Familiar interface for stock investors.
data.risk: Custody concerns. History of trading restrictions. Crypto is secondary product.

data.name: Nexo
data.highlight: Earn interest on BTC. Borrow against crypto. Insurance on custodial assets.
data.risk: Rehypothecation. Single custodian. Regulatory uncertainty in some regions.

data.name: eToro
data.highlight: Social trading features. Copy trading functionality.
data.risk: Spread-based pricing obscures true cost. Limited withdrawal options.

data.name: Binance US
data.highlight: Low trading fees. Deep liquidity on available pairs.
data.risk: Regulatory uncertainty. Parent company controversies.

data.name: Speed (Bitcoin Wallet)
data.highlight: Bitcoin payment processing. Lightning-native. POS integration.
data.risk: Custodial Lightning wallet. Not designed for long-term storage.

data.name: Coinbase Earn
data.highlight: Simple earn interface. Integrated with Coinbase account.
data.risk: Not Bitcoin-native yield. Single custodian. Opaque lending practices.

data.name: SALT Lending
data.highlight: One of the earliest crypto lenders. Multiple collateral types.
data.risk: Past operational issues. Single custodian. Regulatory concerns.

data.name: PayPal
data.highlight: Massive existing user base. Simple interface.
data.risk: Cannot withdraw to external wallet. No self-custody option.

data.name: Bottlepay
data.highlight: Defunct — closed 24 July 2023 (operator notice). Historical record.
data.risk: Closed. The Bottlepay app shut down on 24 July 2023; user accounts were closed and remaining balances returned to nominated bank accounts. This record is kept as history and no longer describes a live custody option.
